[4:37PM] #OkeOdo #TrafficUpdate 

There is smooth vehicular movement from Super/Katangua inward Ile Epo through Ogundare Junction down to Pleasure. The return journey from Pleasure heading back to Ile Epo, en route Super and Oja Oba, is also free-flowing.

Traffic underneath the Jubilee Bridge moving toward the Charity Intersection remains steady. The stretch from Charity to Abattoir and onward to Charity Road, navigating Social Club and Olayiwola, is in good condition.

Both inbound and outbound movements on the Jubilee Bridge at Abule Egba are free of congestion.

Along Mobil to Awori, including the U-turn, Ahmadiyya, and down to Ijaiye, traffic is moving smoothly. However, movement towards Meiran is steady due to an earlier reported vehicle breakdown. The vehicle owner is present and working on repairs, while traffic officers are on ground managing the situation.

There is good traffic flow from Adura, Carso, Kola, Mosalashi, Abucon, and Alakuko down to Ajegunle via Amje. The return journey from Tollgate through Ajegunle, Kola, Meiran, Ijaiye, Ahmadiyya, and Awori back to Abule Egba also maintains a good pace.

#FollowLASTMA

[4:46PM] #EbuteEro #Apongbon #TrafficUpdate 

There is slow vehicular movement when descending from CMS Bridge towards Offin Canal Market, primarily due to heavy traffic flow and ongoing market activities in the area. However, traffic eases up immediately after the Offin Canal Market stretch through to Ijora Olopa, by the NEPA intersection.

Traffic remains steady along Broad Street through Apongbon underbridge, connecting Offin Canal Market and Olowogbowo, largely influenced by closing-hour rush and market-related activities.

Movement on Eko Bridge inward Apongbon and towards CMS remains smooth. Similarly, traffic descending from Idumota Bridge inward Ebute-Ero, Leventis, through UBA Roundabout connecting both inner and outer Marina, is currently free-flowing.

At present, there are no major impediments, and our men are actively on ground managing the situation effectively.

#FollowLASTMA
